result.title: Beyond the Grid: Continuous Dictionary Pursuit for Interpretable Signal Decomposition
result.comment: 10 pages main paper, 3 pages references, 22 pages appendix, to be published in NeurIPS 2026
result.summary: Deep learning models achieve high accuracy in signal processing but remain difficult to interpret. Classical matching pursuit and sparse coding offer better transparency but suffer from spectral leakage and grid mismatch when signal frequencies do not align with discrete dictionary atoms. We introduce Continuous Dictionary Pursuit (CDP), a framework for interpretable signal decomposition that learns the parameters of closed-form functions directly from data. CDP optimizes over a continuous manifold of differentiable atoms and, unlike prior continuous pursuit methods that operate on a single analytic family, searches a heterogeneous library spanning periodic, trend, transient, and discontinuous structures. The algorithm employs a greedy iterative strategy using data-driven priors and gradient-based optimization to isolate individual signal components, with discontinuous waveforms made differentiable through spectral sharpness annealing. To ensure a sparse atom set for reconstruction, the framework utilizes a stopping criterion based on a predefined atom budget and residual error convergence. Evaluations on synthetic and real-world datasets show that CDP removes the grid discretization error for atom families contained in its library, recovers generative parameters to within $1\%$ on stationary synthetic signals expressible in that library, and achieves the best sparsity-accuracy trade-off among classical, continuous-pursuit, and neural baselines in the sparse regime. Beyond decomposition, we demonstrate that the extracted atoms can serve as structured curriculum targets for training sequence models, improving forecasting accuracy over standard end-to-end training on most evaluated datasets. The method offers a glass-box alternative for signal decomposition by providing high reconstruction fidelity alongside direct physical interpretability.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Continuous Dictionary Pursuit，在由周期、趋势、瞬态和不连续结构组成的异构库上，以数据驱动先验和梯度优化贪心搜索可微连续原子，并按原子预算与残差收敛停止，再将提取原子作为序列模型训练的结构化课程目标。
AI.relevance_reason: 其残差驱动的贪心原子选择与预算/收敛停止准则，可供核查 LVR 中逐步获取视觉证据与停止决策的设计；把分解原子用作中间监督目标，也可能与 latent 轨迹的分步监督相参照，但跨域迁移尚需验证。
